issue_types.description: Several pages share the same meta description, so search snippets look identical.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Write page-specific descriptions in generateMetadata.

issue_types.description: Several pages share the same <title>. Search engines can't tell them apart and may show the wrong page.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Generate titles from page-specific data in generateMetadata (service / article / project name + brand).

issue_types.description: The page declares a different URL as canonical, so this URL will not be indexed.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Set alternates.canonical to the page's own URL, or remove this URL from the sitemap/links if it is a duplicate.

issue_types.issue: Sitemap / canonical host is the public domain

issue_types.description: The share image has the wrong size/aspect ratio and will be cropped or shown small.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Create a 1200x630 image (or app/opengraph-image.tsx) for the page.

issue_types.description: The title is outside the recommended length; short titles waste ranking space, long ones are cut off in results.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Rewrite the title: primary topic first, then a differentiator, then the brand.

issue_types.description: The meta description is outside the recommended length.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Expand / tighten the description: what the page offers, who it's for, and a reason to click.

issue_types.description: The page lacks the structured-data type expected for this kind of page.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add JSON-LD of that type with its required properties.

issue_types.description: The H1 is too short to describe the page.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Rewrite the H1 to state the page's topic clearly.

issue_types.description: The image URL returns an error, so a broken image is shown.
issue_types.expected_value: Image URL returns HTTP 200 with an image content type
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fix the src path or restore the file in /public.

issue_types.description: The image URL returns an error, so a broken image is shown.
issue_types.expected_value: Image URL returns HTTP 200 with an image content type
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fix the src path or restore the file in /public.

issue_types.description: A heading element contains no text (often icons only or content rendered later).
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add text to the heading or replace it with a non-heading element.

issue_types.recommended_fix: Add JSON-LD of that type with its required properties.

issue_types.description: hreflang annotations are missing, so search engines may show the wrong language version.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Set alternates.languages in metadata for every page.

issue_types.description: Meta keywords are ignored by Google and reveal your keyword strategy to competitors.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Remove metadata.keywords; put topics in title, H1, body text and alt text instead.

issue_types.description: A social sharing tag is missing, so shared links look generic or pick random text/images.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Fill openGraph and twitter in the page's metadata (Next.js renders the tags).

issue_types.description: The page has an FAQ section but no FAQPage schema.
issue_types.expected_value: FAQPage JSON-LD with each question and answer
issue_types.recommended_fix: Generate FAQPage JSON-LD from the same FAQ data the page renders.

issue_types.issue: Empty alt (only OK for decorative images)
issue_types.description: The image has an empty alt, which is only correct when it is purely decorative.
issue_types.expected_value: A descriptive alt for meaningful images; alt="" only for decoration
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add descriptive alt text, or mark decorative images aria-hidden="true".

issue_types.description: The page is heavier than the performance budget.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Remove unused code/images, compress assets, lazy-load below-the-fold content.

issue_types.issue: Description doesn't mention the title topic
issue_types.description: The page's topic (taken from the URL slug / title) is missing from this element, weakening relevance signals.
issue_types.expected_value: mentions one of: detection, powered, semantic, vulnerability
issue_types.recommended_fix: Include the page's primary topic words naturally in the element named in Issue.

issue_types.description: The page has little text in <main>; thin pages rarely rank.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Expand the content: explain the topic, add examples, FAQs, benefits, process, results.

issue_types.description: The page lacks the structured-data type expected for this kind of page.
issue_types.expected_value: The schema.org type named in Expected value
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add JSON-LD of that type with its required properties.

issue_types.description: No crawled page links to this URL; it can only be found through the sitemap. Orphan pages get little authority and are often treated as unimportant.
issue_types.expected_value: At least one contextual internal link from a related page
issue_types.recommended_fix: Link to the page from its hub/listing page, navigation, related-content blocks or breadcrumbs.

issue_types.description: The anchor text ('read more', 'click here') says nothing about the target page.
issue_types.expected_value: Anchor text that describes the target (e.g. 'Read the React migration case study')
issue_types.recommended_fix: Rewrite the link text, or add an aria-label with the descriptive text.

issue_types.issue: Title and H1 share no topic words
issue_types.description: The page's topic (taken from the URL slug / title) is missing from this element, weakening relevance signals.
issue_types.expected_value: H1 shares a topic word with the title (Careers — Join Our Team | Semicolon)
issue_types.recommended_fix: Include the page's primary topic words naturally in the element named in Issue.

issue_types.description: The image has no width/height, so the layout jumps when it loads (CLS).
issue_types.expected_value: width and height attributes (or next/image fill inside a sized container)
issue_types.recommended_fix: Pass width/height to <Image> or use fill with a sized parent.

issue_types.description: The main text is identical to another page, so search engines pick one and ignore the others.
issue_types.expected_value: Unique main content on every indexable page
issue_types.recommended_fix: Write unique content, merge the pages (301-redirect one), or canonicalise the copy to the original.

issue_types.description: The image file is larger than needed, slowing the page.
issue_types.expected_value: Under ~300 KB per image, sized to its display size
issue_types.recommended_fix: Compress the image, serve WebP/AVIF through next/image and provide correct sizes.

issue_types.description: The URL redirects to another URL. Linking to (or listing) a redirecting URL costs an extra request and dilutes link signals.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Replace the link / sitemap entry with the final URL shown in Current value.

issue_types.description: The URL is harder to read or share (uppercase, underscores, encoded characters, IDs, parameters or too long/deep).
issue_types.expected_value: Short, lowercase, hyphen-separated, descriptive URLs without parameters
issue_types.recommended_fix: Rename the route/slug (e.g. /blog/my-article), and 301-redirect the old URL to the new one.

issue_types.description: Browser/app metadata is missing or incomplete.
issue_types.expected_value: favicon, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, site name and a complete web manifest
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add the missing icon/manifest field via the Next.js special files or metadata.
